intro: This intermediate step in the investigation of Ashenvale's corruption sends Alliance adventurers deep into the sacred groves east of Iris Lake. Entrusted with a recovered Glowing Gem, you must consult the dryad Shael'dryn to learn how to restore Dartol's ancient rod.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.
A dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.
Keep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, Raene sent you? It must be serious indeed. What can I help you with?
